metadata.description: A family archive: lineage, tree, profiles, events and photos of one family.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.tooLong: Too long — {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} max.
validation.tooShort: At least {min, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
validation.familyNameConfirm: Enter the family name to confirm
validation.slugFormat: Latin letters, digits and hyphens only — no spaces or special characters
validation.focusPersonRequired: Choose a person to focus the tree on
validation.sharePasswordMin: Password must be at least 4 characters

auth.loginDescription: Sign in to continue with your family archive.
auth.staleSession: Your session has expired — please sign in again.
auth.registerDescription: Create an account to begin your first family tree.
auth.name: Name
auth.brandTagline: A family archive that stays with you
auth.invalidCredentialsFormat: Enter a valid email and password.
auth.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.

families.title: My families
families.heading: Your families
families.lead: Each archive keeps its own lineage, people and history.
families.emptyBody: Create an archive, add yourself, your parents and loved ones — the tree grows on its own as you remember your relatives.
families.newLead: This becomes a separate archive — you can invite relatives to edit people, events and photos later.
families.descriptionPlaceholder: A few words about the archive

familyNav.treeDescription: An interactive map of family connections

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired — please sign in again.
errors.lastOwner: A family must always have at least one owner.
errors.slugInvalid: The link may only contain Latin letters, digits and hyphens (2–64 characters).
errors.slugTaken: This link is already used by another family.
errors.personNotInFamily: This person isn't in this family.
errors.familyNameMismatch: The name doesn't match — type it exactly as shown.
errors.alreadyMember: This email already belongs to a family member.
errors.invitationNotFound: Invitation not found or already used.
errors.invitationWrongEmail: This invitation was sent to a different email.
errors.focusPersonHidden: The link's focus person must be visible under the chosen access mode.

familyHome.peopleDescription: Profiles, search by name and year
familyHome.photosDescription: The family's photos, videos and documents
familyHome.mapDescription: Places of birth, residence and events
familyHome.activityEmpty: No activity yet — changes made by family members will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.treeDescription: A personal setting — only you see it.
settings.membersDescription: Manage access to the family archive.
settings.shareDescription: Anonymous, read-only access to the family's public data — no sign-up and no editing rights.
settings.activityDescription: Who changed what in the archive — visible to the owner only. Last 10 entries.
settings.slugWarning: The old link will stop working for every family member — including saved bookmarks.
settings.deleteBody: All people, relationships, events, media and stories of this family will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmLabel: To confirm, type the family name: {name}
settings.deleteRowBody: Permanently deletes the family and all its data — people, relationships, events, media and stories.
settings.focusHint: Just for you — other family members see the tree from their own point.

roleDescriptions.owner: Full access: manages members and settings, can edit and delete everything.
roleDescriptions.editor: Can edit the tree, profiles and events — like an owner, but without managing members.
roleDescriptions.contributor: Can add events, photos and stories, but can't edit other people's entries.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Can only view the tree and profiles, without changing anything.

members.inviteCreated: Invitation created. If the email doesn't arrive, send this link manually:
members.removeBody: {name} will immediately lose access to all of this family's data.

shareLinks.created: Link created. Save it now — it can't be shown again, only revoked and replaced.
shareLinks.noPublicPeople: No one is marked “public” — mark at least one person in their profile, or choose “Everything family members can see”.
shareLinks.noPeople: There are no people in this family yet.

invite.title: Family invitation
invite.notFoundBody: This link is invalid or has already been used.
invite.acceptedBody: If that was you, just sign in to your account.
invite.askResend: Ask the family owner to send the invitation again.
invite.heading: Invitation to the “{family}” family
invite.bodyGuest: {inviter} invites you to join as “{role}”. Sign in or sign up to accept the invitation.

share.title: Family tree
share.protectedBody: Enter the password you were given with the link.
share.notFoundBody: Check that you copied it completely.
share.expiredBody: Ask the archive owner to create a new link.
share.revokedBody: Ask the archive owner to share a new link.
share.goneBody: This content is no longer available via this link.

email.subject: Invitation to the “{family}” family archive
email.greeting: {inviter} invites you to join their family's archive on Root house — a shared tree, stories and photos.
email.greetingAnonymous: You've been invited to join a family archive on Root house — a shared tree, stories and photos.
email.heading: You're invited to a family archive
email.fallbackLink: If the button doesn't work, copy this link:
email.validity: The link is valid for 7 days. If you weren't expecting this email, just ignore it — no one will be given access.
email.footer: Root house — a family archive that stays with you
